figurative_meaning_en: The current era or cycle of time
example_sentences_in_bangla: কালচক্রের এই পরিবর্তনে আমরা নতুন সুযোগ খুঁজে পাব।
example_sentences_in_english: In this cycle of time, we will find new opportunities.
Everything changes with the wheel of time.
history: References the philosophical concept of Kalachakra from Hindu and Buddhist traditions, symbolizing the eternal cycle of time and cosmic events.
note: This idiom draws from ancient Indian philosophical ideas, often used metaphorically for inevitable change.
